name: translate-book
title_zh: 整本书拆给多个分身并行翻译，再拼回原排版
tagline_zh: 一本书几十万字，串行翻要等到天荒地老。它用并行子 agent 分块同时翻，保留原书排版，输出 HTML/DOCX/EPUB。
tagline_en: Translates whole PDF/DOCX/EPUB books into any language — parallel sub-agents chunk and translate at once, layout preserved, multi-format out.
desc_en: Translate books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel sub-agents. Converts input -> Markdown chunks -> translated chunks -> HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF.
why_zh: 并行是关键：把几小时压到几十分钟，而且排版不散——这才让「翻整本书」从设想变成可做的事。
why_en: Parallel sub-agents are the trick — serial translation of a whole book takes forever; chunked parallelism cuts hours to minutes, layout intact.
limit_zh: 本机要有 python3 和 pandoc，DOCX/EPUB/PDF 还得装 Calibre，缺了只剩 HTML。默认放 8 个子 agent 并发，整本书的 token 你自己付；术语表只从 5 个抽样块里提。
limit_en: Needs python3 and pandoc locally; DOCX/EPUB/PDF conversions require Calibre, otherwise you only get HTML. Default 8 parallel sub-agents, so the whole book is billed as tokens, and the glossary is extracted from only 5 sampled chunks.
title_en: Translate whole books via parallel sub-agents, rebuild.
